subject.title: feat(apps,ui): question surface parity and composer takeover

question: Should persistent terminal question summaries, native Skip, and Control UI composer takeover become the supported cross-platform question contract after the channel support boundary is documented or expanded?
rationale: This PR changes long-lived user interaction semantics across Apple, Android, and web rather than only repairing one established implementation, and the protected maintainer label requires explicit human direction.

options.title: Sponsor the unified surface contract
options.body: Confirm the intended native/web behavior, correct the channel-facing documentation or add channel cancellation, and require complete native runtime proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow the PR
options.body: Keep the independently acceptable client fixes but defer composer takeover or persistent-summary policy to a smaller separately sponsored change.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the unified surface contract
recommendation.body: Confirm the intended native/web behavior, correct the channel-facing documentation or add channel cancellation, and require complete native runtime proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The current branch and self-assignment show the strongest available connection to the cross-client question design and implementation.
